text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Around lunchtime on a holiday. Having been 
invited by Gran Alegria, we were heading 
to her top-recommended soba shop in town.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I put in a request at the 
cafeteria! Asking them to serve salad soba 
just like they do with udon~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's packed with protein and vitamins, so 
it's perfect for getting faster!
choice_data_list: You really do love soba, huh.
You really do love soba, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes, of cooourse! I mean—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Soba is like a whole galaxy~☆

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Authentic 100% buckwheat soba, and 
mugwort-infused noodles with an herbal 
aroma... Soba is so vast, so profound! 
It's a whole universe!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
With all the different broths and 
toppings, the combinations are endless☆ 
Like countless stars sparkling in the 
galaxy~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer! Please enjoy the taste of the 
shining stars today!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My top recommendation is... the Tempura 
Soba! The aroma of sesame oil hits you 
from 120 miles away!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
âLook, look! While we were chatting, it 
came into view~âª

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: W-W-Whoa—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Wanko soba~?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-Wh-What am I gonna do~?! I came to 
Planet Tempura Soba today, you know?!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh! Still, wanko sobaaa!! W-Wanko soba 
galaxyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I wanna swim all the way in~~!! Right 
through a galaxy of buckwheat flour bigger 
than the sun~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Gran Alegria holds her head in distress. 
I don't mind any of them, but it seems 
I'll need to give advice with how much she 
can eat in mind."
choice_data_list:
I-I'm kinda missing the smell of sesame 
oil~?
...All right, charge into the wanko soba!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ――Ah! Oh no, oh no, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Eating tempura soba with Trainer! It'll be 
a slurpable, crispy adventure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria remembered her initial 
purpose. Afterward, we enjoyed the 
fragrant tempura soba together.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? You're actually up for this, 
Trainer-san?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, today... from the top of our 
heads to the tips of our toes, let's cover 
ourselves completely in buckwheat flour!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Big Baaaang!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gran Alegria thoroughly enjoyed an 
incredible amount of wanko soba!
